svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as in Articles 9.15.1.2. and 9.15.1.3.,
this Section applies to foundations not
subject to surcharge on stable soils with an
allowable bearing pressure of 75 kPa (1 566
psf) or greater
(a) concrete or unit masonry walls and concrete
footings, for wood-frame or masonry buildings,
(b) wood-frame walls and wood or concrete
footings, for wood-frame buildings, and (c) flat
ICF walls and concrete footings, for light-frame
or flat ICF buildings not more than 2 storeys in
building height with a maximum floor-to-floor
height of 3 m (9′-10⅛″).
Foundations for other applications are
designed in accordance with Section 9.4.
Note A-9.4.4.6. and 9.15.1.1.: these solutions
only account for drained earth, taken as a
fluid of density 480 kg/m³ (30.0 lb/ft³)
Surcharges from saturated soil or heavy objects
next to the building need design to Part 4. Note
A-9.15.1.1.: decks, balconies and verandas are
buildings, so this Section applies to them.
Drawn: foundations cut through. B: grey arrows drained earth pressure, red arrows load from the object.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.15.1.1. (page 9-117)
